This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed to enhance the compensation award dated 10.11.2022 made in M.C.O.P.No.155 of 2018 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal/1st Additional Sub Judge, Cuddalore.

sentences.text: 2. The appellant/claimant filed a claim petition under Section 166(1) of M.V. Act, claiming compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- for the injuries caused him in the road accident on 25.07.2017.
3. The learned Tribunal after hearing both sides and upon considering the oral and documentary evidence has granted compensation Rs.7,87,828/- in the following manner:-

The Tribunal directed the above compensation to be paid by the respondent with interest at the rate of 7.5% p.a.
5. The appellant/claimant, not being satisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal,, has filed this appeal seeking enhancement of compensation award.

6. The learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the accident happened in the year 2017 but the Tribunal, without considering the monthly income of Rs.25,000/- erroneously fixed at Rs.10,000/-.

He further submitted that the Tribunal without considering the nature of the injury &
and the effect of the same in the earning capacity of the injured, erroneously granted compensation for permanent disability by the percentage method instead of applying the multiplier method.
He further https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the respondent submitted that the Tribunal taking into consideration all the relevant documents has rightly fixed the compensation, which does not require any interference.
Hence, he prayed for dismissal of this appeal.
8. In the instant case, the accident occurred in the year 2017.

Considering the cost of living at the time of accident in 2017, this Court is enhanced the amount of monthly income Rs.15,000/-x 6000 =90,000/- and on perusal of the disability certificate, it reveals that the petitioner has not having any amputation, therefore, this Court is enhanced the amount of Rs.7000x35% = Rs2,45,000/-
In other aspects, the amount awarded by the Tribunal appears to be reasonable.

Therefore, the Compensation award by the Tribunal is reworked as tabulated below:-
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

Permanent or Partial Rs.1,75,000/- Rs.2,45,000/- enhanced disability (7,000/35%)
2. Pain and suffering Rs.1,00,000/- Rs.1,00,000/- confirmed 3. Loss of income Rs.60,000/- Rs.90,000/- enhanced 4.
Medical Expenses Rs.3,77,828/- Rs.3,77,828/- confirmed 5.
Extra Nourishment Rs.25,000/- Rs.25,000/- confirmed 6.
Attender Charges Rs.30,000/- Rs.30,000/- confirmed 7.
Travel Expenses Rs.10,000/- Rs.10,000/- confirmed 8.

Comfort and Amenities Rs.10,000/- Rs.10,000/- confirmed Total Rs,7,87,828/-
Rs.8,87,828/-
9.

In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed in part and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.7,87,828/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.8,87,828/- together with interest @ 7.5% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of deposit.

The respondent is directed to deposit the entire award amount now determined by this Court along with interest, less the amount already deposited, if any, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment, to the credit of M.C.O.P.No.155 of 2018 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal/1st Additional Sub Judge, Cuddalore.
